verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Knowledge as a scoped, permissioned page graph that agents read and update. It also says edits reach agents on their next turn and that connected sources like Slack and Monday keep it current. That is content propagation and sync, not user-defined rules that fire actions on events, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit. A knowledge platform could plausibly offer event triggers, so the axis applies and absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
